title: Clarkdale Cement Plant as egress to secret facility

tellings.quote: there's an egress point into this whole secret facility called the Clarkdale Cement Plant.

plain: The Clarkdale Cement Plant in Clarkdale, Arizona, is said to be an exit point, an "egress point", into a whole secret underground facility. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels this as something he was told, in an episode about what he calls a UFO base in Arizona; if true, an ordinary industrial site would be hiding the way into a hidden base.
